meta.title: Chronos Meet — Smart white-label videoconferencing
meta.description: Open-source videoconferencing with your own visual identity, live captions, and a copilot that turns meetings into Chronos tasks.
meta.ogDescription: Rooms with your company brand, live captions, and automatic minutes integrated with the Chronos board.

hero.subtitle: Open-source videoconferencing hosted on your domain. Every room inherits the logo, colors, and typography from the Chronos board — and you leave with minutes, decisions, and tasks already created.
hero.ctaOpenSourceAria: Download Chronos Meet on GitHub — MIT open source
hero.ctaOpenSourceHint: MIT · fork, remix, and self-host with full creative freedom — built for the developer community.

features.description: A lean SFU, a copilot that understands Portuguese, and a brand engine that repaints the entire room in real time.
features.item1Body: Logo, palette, typography, background, and custom CSS per room. Participants see the client brand — never ours.
features.item2Body: Real-time transcription via Deepgram Nova-3 multilingual, delivered over LiveKit data channels.
features.item3Body: When you end, the copilot summarizes decisions and opens cards on the Chronos board via MCP.
features.item4Body: Your own SFU on your VPS, optional E2E, and no media flowing through third parties.
features.item5Body: Pure WebRTC in the browser. Link, name, and you're in — desktop or mobile.
features.item6Body: ICS export per room and sync with board task deadlines.

brandShowcase.description: Chronos Meet reads the visual identity attached to the board and propagates CSS tokens to lobby, grid, controls, and captions. Switch a preset and watch the UI morph.

copilot.description: A four-stage pipeline runs inside your infrastructure while the meeting happens.
copilot.stepCaptureCaption: The agent joins the room as a silent participant.
copilot.stepTranscribeCaption: Deepgram Nova-3 returns Portuguese text, word by word.
copilot.stepReasonCaption: Gemini 2.5 Flash separates decisions, risks, and owners.
copilot.stepActCaption: Cards appear on the Chronos board via MCP, with owner and due date.
copilot.connectedBody: Invisible participant, no audio or video published.
copilot.transcript1: Ana: the Vestra pilot needs to close by Friday.
copilot.transcript2: Caio: legal still hasn't approved the contract.
copilot.transcript3: Duda: I'll take the contract today and follow up early tomorrow.

infra.description: Every component runs on your VPS and can be swapped. No per-seat license, no recording in someone else's cloud.
